## Three-frame performance evaluation (#62)

Compare decoration-off, full v1.0 three-frame coverage and coverage plus sidebar text/existing separators in the same build. Keep device, data, window, DPR, theme and actions identical, with at least three runs per group. Fix the random seed for comparison, then assess natural randomness. Include idle, single control, rapid cross-control/navigation, typing/scrolling and fixture message streaming with effects.

Record main-thread construction/update time, input-to-next-paint/click-feedback p50/p95, frame intervals/long frames, long tasks and available paint/compositing metrics. Include CPU and peak/recovered memory for relevant processes including WebView, plus effect/node/timer cleanup. Mark unavailable GPU/energy metrics NOT_TESTED. Report absolute values and deltas from decoration-off, compare FE-00/02 responsiveness evidence, and never infer resource percentages from node counts.

In real macOS Tauri verify distinguishable frames, readable text, stable caret/selection and interruption; Master judges aesthetics and perceptible stutter. Optimize construction, reuse and cleanup when bottlenecks appear, preserving three logical frames. Browser previews cannot replace native performance acceptance. No such measurements or paid model calls were performed in #61.
